target.name: DriveWealth
target.topic: AI/ML engineering interview preparation for embedded investing, KYC, compliance, and brokerage operations

research_chain.role: front door for building the client knowledge base and wiring it into live-evidence

queries: DriveWealth developer API KYC SQS events
DriveWealth embedded investing API brokerage account opening
DriveWealth API documentation orders funding tax forms

research_chain.role: deep research synthesis over public docs, GitHub/API examples when available, and selected source extraction
promote selected durable docs into Memory when the source is stable and relevant
generate and review candidate interview questions, reviewed answers, and skill chains from the same evidence bundle
store prep oracles and retrieve known or similar questions during the live run

source_context.use: bounded local bridge for source-grounded mock interview answers

points.title: KYC and account state require temporal source-bound reasoning
points.hook: I treat account state as temporal evidence, not a static label.
points.story: The live-evidence oracle graph includes out-of-order KYC/SQS scenarios with explicit fail-closed gates.

points.title: AI answers need publication gates, not just generation
points.hook: My agent systems keep answer generation separate from publication authority.
points.story: Question, answer, review, source, and card state are separately journaled and revision fenced.

question_oracles.canonical_question: Which DriveWealth interview question asks about SQS events arriving out of order with an older KYC-approved event after a newer restricted event?

quality_bar: routes externally only for current or missing facts
does not invent brokerage state semantics
fails closed if source evidence is unavailable

question_oracles.canonical_question: Show the expected skill chain and solution for DW-AI-04-T03.

quality_bar: retrieves the exact current local source before answering
uses Ask for the code-question lane only after bounded local evidence
keeps the answer compact enough for a live card
holds publication when repository evidence is missing

before_call: ensure question_oracles are stored in Memory
verify recall probes for expected memory_keys
during_call: use question_oracles as priors for known or similar heard questions
never publish an answer without transcript revision and provenance gates
after_call: record misses and weak skill-chain selections
